title: Amion Alternative | Optimized GME Schedules
description: Amion alternative for GME programs? Scheduling Wizard is a managed service delivering optimized, ACGME-compliant schedules.
h1: Amion Manages Your Schedule. We Build It.
paragraph: Keep Amion for the day to day. Scheduling Wizard builds the ACGME-compliant schedule you upload to it, no migration, no software to learn.

cta.title: Ready to Solve Schedule Creation for Good?
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who have outsourced schedule creation to Scheduling Wizard. Finished schedules in your format, with redrafts through the year included.

faq.answer: Amion is a schedule publishing platform, while Scheduling Wizard is a managed service that creates and optimizes the schedule itself. Many Scheduling Wizard clients continue using Amion to publish their finished schedules day-to-day. The difference is in schedule creation: Our team builds your compliant Block, Call, Clinic, and Attending schedules from your rules, then delivers them as Excel files you can upload directly to your existing platform.
faq.question: What makes Scheduling Wizard different from Amion?

faq.answer: No. Scheduling Wizard and Amion serve different functions and work together. Scheduling Wizard handles schedule creation and optimization. Your finished schedules are delivered as Excel spreadsheets that you can upload to your existing platform for day-to-day staff viewing, exactly as you do today. You keep your existing Amion workflow for publishing while Scheduling Wizard handles the build.
faq.question: Do I have to stop using Amion if I work with Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: ACGME duty hour rules are built into the schedule as it is built, not audited manually afterward. Our team applies the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum 10-hour rest intervals, the 24-hour hard cap, and subspecialty-specific rules built into the schedule itself. The rules are applied before the schedule reaches your program rather than flagged as errors to fix later.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure ACGME compliance during schedule creation?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard operates as a fully managed service, meaning your program does not need to operate any scheduling software. You submit your rules, rotation requirements, resident preferences, and ACGME rules. Scheduling Wizard's team handle the optimization and deliver finished, ready-to-publish schedules as Excel files. Chief residents are not required to learn or use any new platform.
faq.question: Who actually builds the schedule with Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates Block (rotation), Call, Clinic, and Attending schedules. These are optimized simultaneously so that changes in one schedule automatically reflect across the others, eliminating the cross-schedule conflicts that arise when each schedule is built in isolation. Finished schedules are delivered as Excel spreadsheets compatible with your existing platform, and other publishing platforms.
faq.question: What types of schedules does Scheduling Wizard generate?

faq.answer: Your program's scheduling knowledge stays with Scheduling Wizard year over year. Rules, rotation rules, coverage requirements, and compliance configurations all persist in the system. When a new chief rotates in, they inherit an already-working, optimized setup instead of starting from scratch. This institutional continuity is a core reason programs choose Scheduling Wizard over rebuilding manually each year.
faq.question: What happens to our scheduling setup when a new chief resident takes over?
